name: print-social-good-friday-car-tracks-red-distressed-type-ad
title: Good Friday Ad with Red Tyre Tracks
whatItIs: A square holiday ad for a cab brand on off-white: a crown of thorns at the top right, a car seen from above at the head of two red tyre tracks that run to the bottom edge, a red distressed condensed 'GOOD FRIDAY', a line 'Not all journeys are easy. Some change everything.', the logo and contact icons.
whatItMeans: Turning the tyre tracks into red paint or blood links the brand's journeys to the holiday's meaning with a single image and few words.
techniques: Tyre tracks doubling as a red brush stroke
Overhead car shot on an empty ground
Red as the only colour on white
Symbolic prop (thorns) at the frame edge
bestFor: Concept ads that pair product and meaning

vocabulary.definition: An image that reads two ways at once.
An image taken from directly above the subject.
